sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: This site is published in a personal capacity by Alex Martin. For any question about your data: {email}.

sections.heading: Data collected
paragraphs: Without your consent, no audience measurement takes place. The site only stores your language and your cookie choice in your browser; this information never leaves your device.

With your consent, Google Analytics (through Firebase) measures the pages and sections viewed, résumé downloads and clicks on project links, along with technical information: browser, device type, approximate country. This data does not identify you by name.
Like any host, Netlify keeps technical logs (IP address, date, requested page) for the site’s security. Fonts are hosted on the site itself: no third-party service serves them.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal basis
paragraphs: Audience measurement shows whether the site is visited and which parts interest visitors; it relies on your consent. Hosting and displaying the site rely on the publisher’s legitimate interest in running it.

sections.heading: Recipients and transfers
paragraphs: Only the publisher looks at the statistics. The technical providers are Google (Analytics, Fonts) and Netlify, companies based in the United States; these transfers are covered by the safeguards provided by the GDPR (EU–US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses). No data is sold or used for advertising.

sections.heading: Retention periods
paragraphs: Google Analytics cookies: 13 months at most. Statistics in Google Analytics: 14 months. Your cookie choice: 6 months, after which you are asked again.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can withdraw your consent at any time via “Manage cookies” at the bottom of the page.

You have the right to access, rectify, erase, object to and restrict the processing of your data: write to {email}. As the statistics are pseudonymous, please include the value of your _ga cookie if possible so they can be found.
If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr) or, in Morocco, the CNDP (cndp.ma).
